subject: MAP draft: Alignment on target close & procurement signature deadline

Subject: MAP draft: Alignment on target close & procurement signature deadline

Hi Hannah / Rajesh —

Great to meet earlier today. Per our call, attached is Redwood MAP v1.2 (PDF) with the milestone timeline we discussed. Key items to confirm:

- Target commercial close: 2027-04-15 (customer-side go/no-go)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2027-04-22 (last day your procurement team can sign to meet onboarding target)
- Onboarding start: week of 2027-04-25 (dependent on signed SOW + environment access)

Milestones & owners (high level):
- Legal review (FintechCo legal) — deadline 2027-04-08 — Owner: Rajesh
- Procurement PO / signature (FintechCo procurement) — deadline 2027-04-22 — Owner: procurement@fintechco.com
- Security review (Redwood security questionnaire + evidence) — target 2027-04-05 — Owner: Marissa/Redwood SE (Dev)
- Pilot kickoff / access (FintechCo engineering + Redwood SE) — target 2027-04-25 — Owner: Dylan/Dev

Dependencies called out in the MAP: A1) Completed security questionnaire and SOC evidence; A2) Network/VPC peering details (for Private deployment or Dedicated connectivity); A3) PO or signed MSA.

Please review the attached and highlight any date conflicts or missing owners. If 4/15 for target commercial close is aggressive on your side, tell us what end date you prefer and we can update the MAP.

Next step: I propose a 20-minute alignment call next Monday 3/29 to confirm procurement timeline and who from your side will own signature. Does 10:00am PT work?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0127

Subject: Re: MAP draft: Alignment on target close & procurement signature deadline

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from legal/procurement side:

- Legal: Rajesh will aim to complete the redline review by 2027-04-09 (they're out for a day next week).
- Procurement: Our procurement lead says signature by 4/22 is probably tight given internal PO cycles; realistically they can commit to signature by 4/28. They can prioritize if we push for an earlier calendar, but it means expediting the PO approval.
- Security: We'll need the SOC-2 artifact and the answers to the questionnaire by 2027-04-01 for our security team to start validation.

We can meet 3/29 at 10:00am PT — I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Hannah

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Hannah. Noted that procurement is more comfortable with 4/28 for signature. Two small asks so we can update the MAP:

1) Can procurement confirm whether an internal PO will suffice for onboarding, or do you require a signed MSA + PO? (If MSA required, please flag legal priority)
2) We'll get SOC2 artifact + completed questionnaire to you by 4/01 EOD. Dev, can you confirm the artifact delivery timeline?

If procurement confirms 4/28, we will shift the commercial close to 2027-04-20 in the MAP to leave a short buffer before signature. Sharing an updated MAP after the call.

Marissa

- Procurement confirmed they expect signature on 2027-04-28 (internal PO acceptable; MSA not required for first year pilot) — Owner: Procurement Team (procurement@fintechco.com)
- Commercial target close adjusted to 2027-04-20 to allow legal signoff and internal approvals
- Redwood to deliver SOC2 extract + questionnaire by 2027-04-01 (Owner: Dev Patel)
